# 42 Maxims

> 42 Maxims collects short rules for life that recur across religions, philosophies and periods. Every maxim lists exact quotes, each with its voice, work and locus (chapter, verse or page), translation, tradition, period and a verification label (verified, probable, disputed, unverified, misattributed). Maxims are ranked by Moral Rank, which measures how widely and independently traditions arrived at an idea (convergence, not truth or moral worth); ranks shift as sources are added.

When citing, link the maxim page and quote the wording exactly as shown there, with its source. Treat `probable` quotes as checked only against a secondary source, and do not attribute `unverified` or `misattributed` quotes to the people they are popularly credited to. The project's own writing and data are CC BY-SA 4.0; quotes remain the property of their authors and translators.

## Data

- [data/maxims.json](https://42maxims.com/data/maxims.json): Traditions, maxims and every quote with its citation, verification label and relation
- [data/voices.json](https://42maxims.com/data/voices.json): Voices: the people, communities and texts the quotes come from
- [data/sources.json](https://42maxims.com/data/sources.json): Sources: the books, scriptures, talks and articles the quotes are taken from
- [data/generated/scores.json](https://42maxims.com/data/generated/scores.json): Moral Rank and its evidence terms for every maxim (generated)
- [llms-full.txt](https://42maxims.com/llms-full.txt): every maxim with all its quotes and citations as plain text

## Key pages

- [The 42](https://42maxims.com/): the 42 highest-ranked maxims, then Emerging
- [Method](https://42maxims.com/method/): how Moral Rank and verification labels work
- [Themes](https://42maxims.com/themes/): maxims grouped by topic
- [Traditions](https://42maxims.com/traditions/): the maxims each tradition supports
- [Voices](https://42maxims.com/voices/) and [Sources](https://42maxims.com/sources/): who said it and which work it is from
